name: French · Phrases · Emergencies and police
source: Sentences: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org) sentences written by native speakers, each linked in its src, with their English translation; sorted into scenarios by one concept list for every language over the English (scripts/words/scene-lexicon.ts), easiest first by word frequency (FrequencyWords via the frequency lists)
